claims.claim: Spoken / sighted The Needles off the Needles (2d inst 3 PM)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 14 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Germania (Ham), Ehlers, Hamburg April 29,
via Southampton May 2, with mdse and passengers, to Kun-
hardt & Co. 2d inst, 3 PM, off the Needles, spoke steamship
Saxonia; same day, 8 PM, steamship Hansa; 7th, a steamer
supposed to be one of the Royal Mail Steamship Company's;
2d, ship Agra (Br), from Cardiff.
